name: Moire Hoi An, Vignette Collection by IHG
description:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Moire Hoi An, Vignette Collection by IHGElegant Accommodation: Moire Hoi An, Vignette Collection by IHG in Hoi An offers a 5-star experience with spa facilities, a year-round outdoor swimming pool, and wellness packages. Guests enjoy private check-in and check-out, a fitness centre, and a sun terrace.

Dining and Leisure: The family-friendly restaurant serves French, American, Korean, Vietnamese, local, and international cuisines. Dining options include brunch, lunch, dinner, high tea, and cocktails. Additional amenities include a bar, coffee shop, and children's playground.

Prime Location: Located 31 km from Da Nang International Airport, the hotel is situated in the city centre. Nearby attractions include An Bang Beach and the Hoi An Ancient Town. Free WiFi is available throughout the property.
